name: Commentix
description: Add lightweight Commentix comments to Publii posts and pages.
author: TidyCustoms

messageInOptions.text: To show comments, open Theme settings and enable 'Comments' under Post Options or Page Options. You can also enable comments for one post or page under Other Options.

config.name: siteId
config.label: Site ID
config.note: Paste the Site ID shown in the Integration section of your Commentix Console. Paste only the ID, for example ebf94680-ea4a-43f2-a831-933afd61310c. Open Commentix Console.

config.name: language
config.label: Comments language
config.note: Choose the language of buttons and messages in the comments widget. Use the page language to let Commentix read the language set by your Publii site.

config.name: sort
config.label: Default comment order
config.note: Choose how comments are ordered when the widget first opens.

config.name: maxLevels
config.label: Maximum reply depth
config.note: Set how many nested reply levels visitors can create. Commentix uses 3 by default.

config.name: visibleComments
config.label: Initially visible comments
config.note: Set how many top-level comments appear before Commentix shows the button for loading the remaining comments.

config.name: visibleLevels
config.label: Initially expanded reply levels
config.note: Set how many reply levels are expanded when the comments section first appears.

config.name: showCount
config.label: Show comment count
config.note: Display the total number of comments in the widget header.

config.name: enableRating
config.label: Enable comment likes
config.note: Allow visitors to like comments. Turn this off to hide all rating controls.

config.name: textHeader
config.label: Comments heading
config.note: Text shown above the comments section. Leave this field blank to hide the heading.

config.name: headingLevel
config.label: Heading level
config.note: Choose the heading level for the comments title. H2 works for most sites.

config.name: brandColor
config.label: Accent color
config.note: Choose the color used for Commentix buttons, links, and other interactive elements.

config.name: baseSize
config.label: Base interface size
config.note: Set the base size of text, spacing, and controls in pixels. The Commentix default is 16.

config.name: textFallback
config.label: JavaScript disabled message
config.note: Visitors see this message when JavaScript is turned off in their browser.
config.value: Turn on JavaScript to view and post comments.

config.name: cssWrapperClass
config.label: Outer container CSS class
config.note: Theme developers can use this field to change the outer container class. Keep the default value unless your theme requires another class.

config.name: cssInnerWrapperClass
config.label: Inner container CSS class
config.note: Theme developers can use this field to change the inner container class. Keep the default value unless your theme requires another class.

config.name: cssHeaderClass
config.label: Heading CSS class
config.note: Theme developers can add a CSS class to change the heading style. Leave this field blank unless your theme requires a class.

config.name: lazyload
config.label: Load comments when visible
config.note: Commentix waits until the visitor scrolls near the comments before downloading its script. This can reduce the page's initial loading time.

config.name: cookieBannerIntegration
config.label: Require consent before loading
config.note: Optional. Enable this if your privacy setup requires Commentix to wait until the visitor accepts a selected Cookie Group. Commentix states that its widget does not use tracking cookies. Learn how Publii blocks external scripts until consent.

config.name: cookieBannerGroup
config.label: Cookie Group ID
config.note: Enter the Group ID from Site Settings → Privacy Settings → Cookie Groups, for example comments. Use the same ID here and in Privacy Settings. Learn about Cookie Groups.

config.name: cookieBannerNoConsentText
config.label: Message before consent
config.note: Visitors see this message until they accept the selected Cookie Group.
config.value: Comments are unavailable until you allow the external comment service. You can change your choice in Cookie settings.
